about: Land register plan for Procyon City. Generated by tools/plots.mjs from the city model; do not edit by hand.
frame: Centred model coordinates: X east, Y north (three.js x = X, z = -Y). Bearings in degrees clockwise from north around the core.

vault.name: Regolith vault
vault.note: Barrel vaults under a metre of regolith: the oldest way to live on Mars.
vault.note_cn: 覆盖一米风化层的筒形拱屋，火星上最古老的居住方式。

dome.name: Dome
dome.note: A pressurised dome with a ring of windows.
dome.note_cn: 带一圈舷窗的加压穹顶。

tower.name: Tower
tower.note: Stacked floors with setbacks, for homes or offices.
tower.note_cn: 逐层退台的塔楼，住宅或办公。

office.name: Office hall
office.note: A wide hall with bands of glass.
office.note_cn: 带通长玻璃带的宽体楼。

shop.name: Shopfront
shop.note: A street-front shop with an awning and a big sign.
shop.note_cn: 临街商铺，有雨棚和大招牌。

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.note: A glass vault full of crops, glowing at night.
greenhouse.note_cn: 种满作物的玻璃拱棚，夜里会发光。

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.note: Saw-tooth roof, a tank and a crane.

garden.name: Garden
garden.note: Trees, a pond and a low wall: a public garden.
garden.note_cn: 树、池塘和矮墙：一座公共花园。

rings.name: Pioneer Ring
rings.note: The first outpost on the Isidis Plain, April 2070.
rings.note_cn: 2070 年 4 月，伊希地平原上的第一个前哨站。

rings.name: Referendum Ring
rings.note: The city is named by public vote, 17 February 2123.
rings.note_cn: 2123 年 2 月 17 日，全民公决为城市命名。

rings.name: Eleven Cities Ring
rings.note_cn: 2200 年，火星上已有十一座城市。

rings.name: Terraforming Ring
rings.note_cn: 2219 年，地球化改造开始：就是现在。
